name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 2.85V — SOT
description: This cluster contains 3 surface-mount 2.85V LDO linear regulator ICs available in SOT-223-3 and SOT-223-3_TabPin2 footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a fixed 2.85V LDO linear regulator in an SMD SOT package.
Match board layout requirements against SOT-223-3 or SOT-223-3_TabPin2 footprints.
Prefer Tier A parts such as AMS1117-2.85 or NCP1117-2.85_SOT223 over Tier B options.
avoid_when: Avoid when an output voltage other than 2.85V is required.
Avoid when surface-mount SOT packaging is not suitable for the application.
Avoid when the design requires a footprint other than SOT-223-3 or SOT-223-3_TabPin2.
